title: Storey Architecture testimonial
description: A tall black band. At the left: a 4:3 photo slideshow with thin progress bars under it, then a client's short quote in a narrow column beside a small square thumbnail with the client's name and a mono company line. At the top-right: two white paragraphs side by side that lag behind the scroll. Slides crossfade from 105% scale; a wide empty black field closes the band.
notes: drawn with bg-foreground: a black band on light themes, a pale one on dark themes
needs JavaScript for the slideshow (hydrate: visible); without it the first slide shows
the paragraphs' lag (0→27vw) is desktop only; on phones they follow the quote
